page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ine.8xlarge is an x86_64 instance from the Enhanced family, driven by the KVM hypervisor. The configuration includes 32 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB, delivering a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no GPU acceleration hardware.

Storage and networking specifications feature a baseline network throughput of 44 Gbps. The server does not include local disk storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default, requiring dedicated configuration for public internet access.

The 4:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high baseline network bandwidth position the instance for high-throughput networking tasks, distributed enterprise applications, container orchestration nodes, backend web servers, and mid-sized databases relying on attached block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ine.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced family. The system provides 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. There is no integrated local storage or GPU hardware on this instance, meaning all primary storage demands rely on external block storage services. A standout architectural specification is its baseline network throughput of 44 Gbps, which supports heavy network traffic without dedicated hardware accelerators. With zero bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses, the configuration suits networked backplane roles, including microservices, container clusters, multi-tier web applications, and network-intensive enterprise services.
